# Buena Vista

Buena Vista refines the Obsidian interface with small aesthetic and quality-of-life tweaks. It offers color modes that work with the Obsidian accent color, reduces the footprint of embedded notes, standardizes quotes and callouts, and enlarges sidebar tabs and click targets. Visual tweaks for Slides, Outline, Kanban and Breadcrumbs are included.

![Buena Vista screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oqipodev/buena-vista-obsidian/HEAD/img/thumb.png)
